Unique roadmap to consolidate future of U.S. healthcare intellectual property provides once-in-a-generation opportunity for consumers to fight back
A recent Menlo Ventures report notes that healthcare is AI's biggest vertical market with spend growing 2.5x to $3.7B, more than double the next largest vertical (legal)
TAMPA, FL / ACCESS Newswire / November 16, 2026 /
This release is being updated to remove a word from the first line of the original subhead.
DataMeds AI, Inc. ("DataMeds SI," "DataMEDS" or ("DataMEDS" or the "Company")

, a healthcare company that integrates its health information technology and physical infrastructure with its EinsteinRx™ artificial intelligence platform and PharmacyChain™ blockchain-enabled smart contracts platform, today provided a fourth quarter 2026 corporate outlook from its Interim Co-CEO Gerald Commissiong:

"The reality is healthcare in America is broken. To fix it, the focus must go back towards helping the patient, insured or uninsured, who ends up subsidizing the costs. Our business model is rooted in cutting out the middleman so that the payor not only pays a fair price, but more importantly receives beneficial health outcomes as a result. DataMEDS' objective is to narrow the arbitrage between what you are paying for and what you are getting.

To accomplish this daunting task in the face of heavily entrenched and overcompensated stakeholders, we must leverage patients' data to rein in the army of middlemen gouging the industry. Healthcare profits leverage user data to predict future outcomes. To the extent we can do that efficiently, initially in GLP-1 patient management - one of the most expensive pockets of the healthcare ecosystem - we believe we can simultaneously improve outcomes while reducing costs by improving regimen compliance, managing the process of titrating up as therapy is initiated and titrating down as the need for therapeutic intervention lessens, by seamlessly helping to improve patient behavior and providing the right support products at the right time to help manage side effects and helping physicians more efficiently monitor their patients leveraging our technology and intellectual property assets. This is exactly why a Florida-based Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) decided to work with DataMEDS around our Health Lives Here initiative to implement a formulaic process around helping their members manage their health journey. To the extent that we are successful in providing insights that prove useful and deliver better outcomes, lower costs or both, we will have proven a very scalable business model that will allow us to capture more and more institutional payors that see tremendous potential value in our approach and understand that trying to achieve this objective using competitors' platforms violates our healthcare technology intellectual property.

Our physical healthcare infrastructure, which leverages our own pharmacy, lab and telemedicine platforms together with our proprietary independent pharmacy network, allows us to view the different aspects of the healthcare journey through a common lens that creates synergistic revenue streams with each patient interaction. This reduces our reliance on achieving maximum per interaction revenue to instead focus on long-term repeat customers that view our services as a better alternative to their current treatment options, and less risky from an intellectual property litigation standpoint.

The recent acquisition of Helomics underscores our vision to improve outcomes while reducing costs. Cancer, as one of the most devastating health diagnoses a human can receive, is simultaneously one of the most profitable healthcare industries. This type of misaligned incentive structure is what we are seeking to counter through the consolidation of health data, use of artificial intelligence, and quantification of the benefit of various outcomes measurements to fortify the resilience of the artificial intelligence decision making process for the benefit of patients and payors.

To accomplish this objective for the benefit of shareholders, we must create synergies using approaches that may appear disjointed at first glance. For example, we must conduct research and development (R&D), however we must do so profitably by increasing patient flow through our healthcare delivery portals and compliantly leveraging that patient base to create new data inputs that can be used to deliver measurable benefit outputs in the future. We know that most patients are willing to allow their data to be used in a de-identified way to help improve treatment paradigms. In doing so, we expect to create new intellectual property that will add to our proprietary positioning.

As we work to complete the turnaround that began in the second quarter, we are focused on delivering value to patients, organizations that manage patients and shareholders. We would like to thank our stakeholders for their engagement as we work through this process to deliver tangible solutions for the healthcare community."

There are currently 5,724,857 common shares of DataMEDS outstanding, including 2,745,900 common shares deposited in Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) available for trading. Certain stockholders holding approximately 1,333,930 common shares have entered into lock-up agreements that preclude the sale of their shares into the market for at least ninety (90) days from today's date. There are no debt, preferred equity or warrant securities of the Company that are eligible to convert into free trading common shares as of the date of this press release. There is a total of 80,826 cash warrants outstanding, each with a fixed exercise price of $35.00 per share, that are currently eligible to be exercised into free trading common shares. Investors should refer to the Company's filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission for additional information regarding the Company's capitalization and outstanding securities.
About DataMEDS AI
DataMEDS AI, Inc.

, formerly Wellgistics Health, Inc., is a healthcare company focused on the vertical integration of technology, pharmacy, pharmaceutical-adjacent and telemedicine business units through its health information technology platforms to deliver a better experience for consumers and providers. Headquartered in Tampa, Fla., DataMEDS incorporates its EinsteinRx

artificial intelligence platform and PharmacyChain™ blockchain-enabled smart contracts platform into the Health Lives Here mobile application from Tollo Health, LLC, and its pharmacy-related Corexa Health subsidiary provides pharmacy dispensing and pharmacy-related services, including distribution of products developed by Tollo Health. DataMEDS also owns Helomics Corporation, a Pittsburgh, PA-based commercial clinical molecular diagnostics laboratory focused on the ChemoFx® Assay chemotherapy selection diagnostics test that aims to help oncologists make chemotherapy treatment decisions. Learn more at https://datamedsai.com.
